title: Implement & Manage CIS Benchmarks for Windows 11 Devices for Microsoft Intune
author_notes: Shaping note: cover net-new implementation of CIS Benchmarks AND an ongoing update/maintain process for when a new CIS Benchmark version is released or changes.

Effort tier: T3 (multi-control Windows 11 hardening within Intune via settings catalog/imported ADMX, Level 1/Level 2 profiles, compliance reporting and drift, plus a benchmark-version maintenance lifecycle).
hook: Harden every Windows 11 device to the CIS Benchmark — and keep it that way as the benchmark evolves
problem: Security and audit teams increasingly require Windows 11 endpoints to meet the CIS Benchmarks, but doing it by hand is brutal: hundreds of settings, Level 1 vs Level 2 decisions, settings that break business apps, and a benchmark that gets revised every few months so your hard-won baseline silently drifts out of compliance. This solution gives you a repeatable way to implement and then continuously manage CIS Benchmarks for Windows 11 in Microsoft Intune — build the hardened baseline as Intune policy, prove compliance, and run a documented update process every time CIS publishes a new version.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what the CIS Benchmarks are, Level 1 vs Level 2, how the controls map to Intune (settings catalog and imported ADMX) versus the Microsoft security baselines, the compliance/reporting model, and the benchmark-version maintenance lifecycle.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, supported Windows 11 edition, device groups, the official CIS Benchmark/Build Kit source, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide (net-new) — exact, ordered steps: stage the benchmark, build the Level 1 (and optional Level 2) configuration in Intune, handle known break-glass exceptions, assign to a pilot, validate compliance, then expand fleet-wide.

Maintenance & Update Guide — a repeatable process for when CIS releases a new benchmark version: obtain the new version, diff it against your live baseline, assess and approve changes, update the Intune policies in a controlled change, re-validate, and record the version you are on.

5 PowerShell scripts — CIS-readiness discovery, per-device CIS-compliance validation, a fleet CIS posture and drift report, safe remediation of drifted settings, and a benchmark-version comparison helper that diffs a new CIS export against your current baseline.
short: Implement and continuously manage CIS Benchmarks for Windows 11 in Microsoft Intune — build the hardened Level 1/Level 2 baseline as Intune policy, prove compliance, and run a documented update process every time CIS publishes a new version. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
